premises.text: Connected vehicles can be hacked so critical controls leave the driver; recalls show the threat is real
premises.evidence_span: suddenly your car is hacked. Critical control functions, such as steering, braking, and acceleration, is out of your hands

premises.text: Secure IoT is a patented multi-module software stack protecting connected vehicles via encryption, auth, keys, firewall, OTA, and big-data modules
premises.evidence_span: Our core solution is Secure IoT. This is a software-based solution for protecting connected vehicles from hacker attacks

premises.text: Cybersecurity-as-a-service charges fleet owners about $10 per vehicle per month including continuous updates
premises.evidence_span: We charge $10 per vehicle per month to protect them from outside attacks

premises.text: Revenue-sharing deployment path runs through OEMs plus subscription providers (insurance, carriers, security firms)
premises.evidence_span: Our business model is based on a revenue sharing approach where Trillium develops automotive cybersecurity solutions, an automotive OEM deploys our security in their vehicles

premises.text: Differentiation is a multi-layered solution rather than single-point firewall, OTA, or message protection alone
premises.evidence_span: What sets Trillium apart from our competitors is our focus on building a multi-layered solution to protect from outside attacks

premises.text: Cyber-secure onboard systems are a precondition for autonomous, EV, and intended ride-sharing paradigms
premises.evidence_span: Until we have cyber secure vehicles, we will never have autonomous drive

domains.name: Fleet CaaS and OEM revenue share

value.text: Stop car hacking so next-generation mobility can deploy on secure onboard systems
